title: Disaster
author: Must_Dragonfruit
selftext:
anyone can be a genius in a bull market :) 

just be careful when using these models... I just lost $1000 in one day. 

I have opened up all of the anti pilot and flypilot models so you can see their weights... 

and now you can run a model on your own live account... 

shoutout to user user: bigbull they have the best performing model

comments.author: Electrical_Eagle_927
comments.body: My brother in claude, I only gave my real money bot $40, and implementing circuit breakers was like the first thing I did. We live, and we learn. Youll come back from this. I have had negative pnl days this week as well.

comments.author: Objective_Topic_8583
comments.body: Everyone tries to train in kind of market.   Testing against adverse markets is where you find actual quality.   That's why when i created clockoutcapital.com we didn't just test in a bull and push we tested chop, we tested bear, and we created ways to stay profitable in all scenarios

replies.body: Thanks buddy... I just started trading again after a long break. I'm not satisfied with the model yet but I was too eager to start testing it on real live money

comments.author: Any_Object_4577
comments.body: Sorry about the $1k. One thing I've learned is that a strategy's first bad week is often more informative than its first 100 good trades. That's usually where you find out what assumptions it was quietly relying on.
